items.title: Bitcoin ETF demand is the next test, according to the hourly review
items.summary: The Trading Journey report cites Techi analysis identifying the next US ETF trading session as a test of Bitcoin's recovery after Binance resumed withdrawals. This is an outlook, not evidence of new institutional buying.
items.source_time: Source publication reported by ChatGPT: November 1, 2026, 6:57 PM EST
items.caveat: Imported AI research; publisher content and forecast have not been independently verified by TradeZilla.

items.title: Exchange-security and withdrawal risk remain in focus
items.summary: The hourly review cites Reuters coverage of Binance replacing most assets affected by a reported theft while experiencing substantial net withdrawals. The report describes withdrawal activity as stabilizing, but does not establish that withdrawals equal Bitcoin spot selling.
items.source_time: Source publication reported by ChatGPT: November 1, 2026, 05:49 UTC, with subsequent updates
items.caveat: These are claims carried by the ChatGPT report, not independently confirmed facts from TradeZilla. Read the original source before acting.

items.title: ETF flow figures refer to the prior completed session
items.summary: The review cites Farside's October 30 session as showing $643.2 million in net US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows. It explicitly notes that no newer weekend ETF session exists; these figures must not be treated as today's live flows.
